title: First steps with Barsik
description: Meet Barsik, pack his bag and help him find the way from the post office to the market.

first_lesson.title: Hello, Barsik!
first_lesson.description: Learn hello, letter and thank you, then try your first Russian words.

lessons.title: What’s in the bag?
lessons.description: Name the letter, bag and map so Barsik has what he needs.
lessons.resolution: Barsik has his letter and map ready in his bag. Next, help him read the directions.

teaching.title: The letter stays with Barsik.
teaching.explanation: You know письмо. Add это to say what something is. Russian needs no separate word for “is” here.

teaching.title: A bag for the journey.
teaching.explanation: Сумка is a bag. Barsik can carry the letter inside it.

teaching.title: Take a map.
teaching.explanation: Карта means a map here. This one will help Barsik find his way.

questions.prompt: Name the letter Barsik must take with him.
questions.hint: Письмо is a letter. Add это to name it.
questions.feedback: Это письмо. This is the letter for you. Barsik will keep it with him.

questions.prompt: Name the bag that will hold the letter.
questions.hint: Сумка is the word for a bag.
questions.feedback: Это сумка. This is a bag. There is room for the letter and a map.

questions.prompt: Name the map that will help Barsik find the way.
questions.hint: Карта means a map in this lesson.
questions.feedback: Это карта. This is a map. Barsik is ready to look for the route.

lessons.title: Which way?
lessons.description: Learn three direction words to guide Barsik along the map.
lessons.resolution: You have practised straight ahead, left and right. Now help Barsik ask where the market is.

teaching.title: Keep going ahead.
teaching.explanation: Прямо tells Barsik to keep going in the direction he is facing.

teaching.title: Take the left turn.
teaching.explanation: Налево tells Barsik which way to turn. Follow the arrow to the left.

teaching.title: Take the right turn.
teaching.explanation: Направо tells Barsik to turn right. Compare it with налево, to the left.

questions.prompt: Barsik is facing up the map. Tell him to keep going straight ahead.
questions.feedback: Прямо. Barsik keeps going ahead without turning.

questions.prompt: The path turns left. Give Barsik that direction.
questions.feedback: Налево. This is the direction for a left turn.

questions.prompt: This path turns right. Give Barsik that direction.
questions.feedback: Направо. This is the direction for a right turn. You have tried all three directions.

lessons.title: Ask for help
lessons.description: Help Barsik ask the clerk where the market is and thank them for their help.
lessons.resolution: Barsik can ask about the market and ask the clerk to show the way. The next lesson puts the exchange together.

teaching.title: Greet the clerk politely.
teaching.explanation: Use здравствуйте with someone you do not know, such as the clerk. Привет is the informal greeting you use with Barsik.

teaching.title: The first place to find.
teaching.explanation: Рынок is a market. It is the next place on Barsik’s route, not the end of his delivery.

teaching.title: Ask where it is.
teaching.explanation: Где means where. This short question asks for the market’s location.

teaching.title: Ask the clerk to show you.
teaching.explanation: Use this polite request when the clerk can point to the route on a map. Learn it as a useful phrase.

questions.prompt: Which Russian word names the market Barsik is looking for?
questions.hint: Рынок is the market. Карта is a map.
questions.feedback: Рынок means a market. Barsik needs to find this next stop.

questions.prompt: Ask the clerk where the market is.
questions.feedback: Где рынок? This asks where the market is.

questions.prompt: The clerk has a map. Politely ask them to show you the way.
questions.hint: Покажите, пожалуйста means please show me.
questions.feedback: Покажите, пожалуйста. This asks the clerk to show you. The map makes it clear what you mean.

questions.prompt: The clerk has helped Barsik. Say thank you.
questions.hint: Спасибо is the thank-you you learned with Barsik.
questions.feedback: Спасибо! Barsik thanks the clerk for helping.

lessons.title: Ready to set off
lessons.description: Use your words to follow the clerk’s directions toward the market.
lessons.resolution: Barsik leaves the post office with the letter and the route: straight ahead, then left toward the market. The letter is still on its way to you.

teaching.title: Keep the letter ready.
teaching.explanation: The letter stays with Barsik. His bag and map are ready too.

teaching.title: Ask for the next stop.
teaching.explanation: Use the question you practised with the clerk. The market is the next stop.

teaching.title: Put two directions together.
teaching.explanation: Потом means then. Go straight ahead first; make the left turn after that.

teaching.title: Read the clerk’s clue.
teaching.explanation: Там means there. Read it with the directions to see where Barsik should go.
teaching.translation: The market is there. Straight ahead, then left.

questions.prompt: Greet the clerk politely before asking for help.
questions.hint: Здравствуйте is the polite greeting for someone you do not know. Привет is informal.
questions.feedback: Здравствуйте! Barsik greets the clerk politely. Привет is the informal hello you used with Barsik.

questions.hint: Письмо is the letter. Карта is his map.
questions.feedback: Это письмо. The letter is for you; the bag and map help Barsik carry it along the route.

questions.prompt: Read the exchange. Which way should Barsik turn after going straight ahead?
questions.passage:
— Где рынок?
— Рынок там. Прямо, потом налево.
questions.hint: Потом means then. The direction after потом is налево, left.
questions.feedback: Налево. First Barsik goes straight ahead, then he turns left. This is the route the clerk gave him.

questions.prompt: Read the clerk’s clue. What is the next place on Barsik’s route?
questions.hint: Рынок means the market. The clue tells Barsik how to get there.
questions.feedback: Рынок. Barsik now has directions toward the market. The delivery continues from there; he has not reached your doorstep yet.
